records.claim: The use of some antidepressants during pregnancy can cause temporary symptoms in newborns soon after birth. These symptoms are sometimes called withdrawal symptoms. They can include irritability, jitteriness, trouble sleeping, or trouble eating. Not all babies exposed to bupropion will have these symptoms. Two studies have suggested that the chance of these symptoms in newborns may be lower with bupropion than with some other antidepressants. It is important that your healthcare providers know you are taking bupropion so that if symptoms occur, your baby can get the care that is best for them.
records.source_section: I need to take bupropion throughout my entire pregnancy. Will it cause withdrawal symptoms in my baby after birth?
